title: 공공 와이파이 접속: 비밀번호가 있어요? 몇 시간 써요?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean public Wi-Fi screen and find the password, the usage time, and the button that connects you.
summary: Learners read a free public Wi-Fi screen and find the network name, password, time limit and the right button to press.
note: The screens here are examples with made-up names, so a real screen may look a little different.

task.title: Read the Wi-Fi screens
task.line: Read each screen or sentence, then answer in English or choose the right Korean word.

items.text: The wireless internet you choose on your phone.
You do not pay for it.
You type it to join; 없음 means there is no password.
Press it to join the network.
Press it to accept the rules before you use the internet.
Press it to close a message.
This message means the internet works now.
This message means the internet stopped.
How long you can use it at one time.
Press it to join again after you lose the connection.

sections.heading: Read a real-style screen
paragraphs: 하나시 무료 와이파이 | 이름: 하나시_Free_WiFi | 비밀번호: 없음 | 이용 시간: 1시간 (1시간 후 다시 연결하세요) | □ 이용 약관에 동의합니다 | [동의하고 연결]
Tip: First look for 비밀번호 and 이용 시간. 없음 means "none." 1시간 후 means "after 1 hour." Tick the box, then press the button with 동의 or 연결.

exercises: Read the screen and answer in English: 도서관_WiFi · 비밀번호: book2580 · 이용 시간: 2시간 — ① What is the password? ② How long can you use it?
Put the screen messages in order: 접속 완료 / 와이파이를 켜세요 / 약관에 동의하세요 / 와이파이 이름을 고르세요
Choose the right word: 인터넷이 안 돼요. 화면에 '(접속 완료 / 연결 끊김)'이 나왔어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from 'Words on the screen': 이 와이파이는 돈을 안 내요. ____ 와이파이예요.
You want to use the internet. Which button do you press? ① 와이파이 이용 약관 [동의] [취소 (cancel)] ② 1시간이 지났어요 (1 hour has passed). [다시 연결] [닫기 (close)]
answers: 와이파이를 켜세요 → 와이파이 이름을 고르세요 → 약관에 동의하세요 → 접속 완료
